name: Livermore Youth Council (LYC)
what_you_do: Speak up for Livermore youth to the City Council, the park district (LARPD) and the school district (LVJUSD). Members take on projects, promote youth programs and community service, and plan events that celebrate diversity.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students. The municipal code says ages 12 through 20, preferably at Livermore schools, and members at Livermore schools do not have to live in the city. You must be able to come to meetings, sub-committee meetings and events.
pay_detail: Unpaid. No pay is stated on the city page or in the code.
duration: One school year. A new term starts each school year. Three absences in one school year count as resigning.
deadline_text: The city posts a recruitment application form on the Youth Council page. No deadline is shown on the page. A new term starts each school year.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Livermore Youth Council Recruitment Application Form linked on the Youth Council page, and contact the City of Livermore to ask when it is due.
notes: Read in a browser on 2026-10-16. The city's Youth page now calls this group the Livermore Youth Council and links to its page on the library site. The municipal code (Chapter 2.51) still uses the older name, Livermore Area Youth Advisory Commission, with 15 youth seats and 3 adult seats. The application form and rules are PDF downloads that our tools could not open, so the due date is not confirmed. Not a paid job.
